issues.description: Packetization buffer treats every bytes payload as PCM and drops trailing audio at shutdown
issues.detail: _write_frame buffers any bytes payload into _audio_send_buffer when fixed_audio_packet_size is set, with no frame-type gate and no flush on EndFrame/Cancel. Non-PCM binary payloads get sliced and corrupted; trailing PCM shorter than packet_size is silently dropped. Gate on AudioRawFrame and flush (pad with silence) at EOS.

issues.description: Packetization concern leaks Vonage-specific framing into the generic FastAPI transport
issues.detail: 20ms @ 16kHz = 640B is a property of the Vonage protocol and belongs in VonageFrameSerializer, not the generic transport. Pushing fixed_audio_packet_size into FastAPIWebsocketTransport leaks a serializer-specific invariant upward and forces every future protocol to re-negotiate this knob. A composing packetizing serializer would respect the boundary.

issues.description: Missing precondition: fixed_audio_packet_size must align with sample format
issues.detail: fixed_audio_packet_size must be a multiple of bytes_per_sample * channels or the receiver gets misaligned PCM and noise. There is no validation in setup() or __init__; a caller passing 641 silently corrupts every packet. State and enforce the precondition (assert or raise on StartFrame).

issues.description: InterruptionFrame buffer clear races with in-flight websocket sends
issues.detail: process_frame clears _audio_send_buffer before delegating, but if _write_frame is concurrently sending a chunk, stale pre-interruption audio still reaches the wire. The 'no pre-interruption PCM after InterruptionFrame' invariant is not preserved. Needs a send lock or sequence guard.

issues.description: Renaming audio_packet_bytes to fixed_audio_packet_size is a silent breaking change
issues.detail: The param sits on a public dataclass and the rename has no deprecated alias. Because the default is None, existing callers using audio_packet_bytes silently lose packetization rather than erroring. Keep a deprecated alias for one release or flag the break loudly in the changelog.

issues.description: DTMF digit shape is under-specified — code accepts two undocumented variants
issues.detail: deserialize tries message['digit'] then message['dtmf']['digit'] with no spec reference. Pick the documented Vonage shape and treat the other as a compatibility shim with a TODO, or this defensive code hides protocol drift indefinitely.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The Vonage serializer itself is a cleanly shaped ADT, but the FastAPI transport's new packetization path is the main correctness risk: it buffers any bytes payload as PCM, drops trailing audio at shutdown, leaks a Vonage-specific framing concern into a generic transport, and lacks alignment validation. A race between InterruptionFrame buffer clearing and in-flight sends compounds the correctness problem. Secondary concerns are a silent rename of a public dataclass field and an under-specified DTMF digit shape that accepts two undocumented variants.
